proofs.text:
The exact excitation factorization writes the coordinates of w as 

  w(q,t,b,c)=(∏i∈GΩ(qi,ti))χ(b,c).

 Summing the rank-one density over b gives the marginal of χ, which is the actual auxiliary marginal of w. Summing over t factors into one sum per good copy: 

  ∑t∈TG∏i∈GΩ(qi,ti)Ω(qi′,ti)―=∏i∈G(ρQ)qiqi′.

 The chosen enumeration identifies this product with ρQ⊗m. Empty products have value one, so the same calculation includes m=0.
